exposure: volume of bupivacaine used in subarachnoid block (SAB)
cohort: The study included 2086 consenting parturients undergoing Lower Segment Cesarean Section (LSCS) with subarachnoid block (SAB).
finding: The study found that 4.84% of parturients experienced intraoperative chest discomfort/pain during LSCS with SAB, with increasing age and parity decreasing the odds, while comorbidities increased the odds of occurrence.
